label: Having a perfection by participation: ParticipatesIn x r: x has the perfection r by participation…
term: having a perfection by participation (ParticipatesIn x r)
definition: ParticipatesIn x r: x has the perfection r by participation, that is, not through what x is but as something x takes part in. It generalizes Participated (DEF-PARTICIPATED-ESSE, esse by participation) to any perfection. Example: the iron's heat in the fire-heated iron. Non-example: whatever has r through its own essence. It is not a Platonic Form-participant relation (DISAMB-THOMISTIC-ESSE-PARTICIPATION) and not the reception relation ReceivedIn, which the open premise STMT-PARTICIPATED-PERFECTION-IS-RECEIVED-IN-PARTICIPANT links to it.
note: Stipulative analyst generalization, attribution deferred. ST I q.44 a.1 co. and ad 1 use participation for esse only (claim AQUINAS-ST-I-Q44-A1-PARTICIPATED-ESSE-CAUSE); the extension to every perfection is the analyst's.
